periods.time: vol-10 ch-004, revealed during Amane's defeat

name.zh: 天宫紫音因女神恩宠而舍弃自我
name.en: Amamiya Shion abandons himself because of Nameless Glory

periods.summary: Amane remembers childhood as Amamiya Shion. Because his causality luck made every success suspect, classmates, teachers, and rescued children treated him as a cheater or disaster source. His mother initially seemed to love him and said his power was given so he could be happy, but after Shion tried not to use the power for one day and a financial crash ruined the family, she abused him and demanded he make her happy. Eventually his hatred caused his father to appear, covered in his mother's blood, and the father also wanted Shion to love him for the luck. Shion concluded that the world wanted only his power, not him, and abandoned his own self.
periods.cause: Nameless Glory made it impossible for Shion to distinguish earned results from luck, and others valued or feared only the ability.
periods.outcome: Explains Amane's hatred of Ikki, whose earned progress threatens the excuse Amane used to survive his self-abandonment.
periods.significance: Reveals the trauma behind Amane's jealousy and the thematic reason Ikki chooses to save rather than merely defeat him.
